item.skt: karma kra ma nA ma muk+ti kA ba li
item.coloph: las kyi rim pa mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba/ slob dpon b+ha bas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po rdo rje slob dpon bIr+ya gu pa su tra'i zhal snga dang / lo tsA ba dge slong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing zhus te/ dur khrod nags tshal du brgyud pa'i slob dpon la/ shin tu gsang zhing zhus ba'i don lags so
